population_one_line: CoNS bacteraemia patients, tertiary hospital Murcia Spain
outcome_one_line: TTP<16h predicted 'clinical significance' (CSB) classification (OR 4.54 1.73-11.88), not a patient clinical outcome (mortality/persistence)
notes: Outcome is CDC/NHSN-defined clinically-significant bacteraemia classification, not mortality/persistent bacteraemia/clinical failure. Persistent bacteraemia rate reported descriptively only (no TTP↔persistence quantitative analysis).

population_one_line: Candidaemia patients single health network Monash Australia
ttp_reported: TTP available for 23 episodes; C. glabrata 70.6±26.9h vs others 32.5±14.2h (p=0.008)
outcome_one_line: Mortality reported (21% 7d, 37% 30d, 47% 90d) but no TTP↔mortality analysis
notes: Conference abstract (Internal Medicine Journal Suppl 3 RACP Congress 2014). Descriptive only; TTP reported by species, mortality reported overall — no quantitative TTP↔outcome association.

population_one_line: Staphylococcus lugdunensis BSI cohort Mayo Clinic
ttp_reported: TTP collected but no median/cutpoint reported
outcome_one_line: 1-year mortality 45%, skip phenomenon 15.2%; no TTP↔outcome quantitative association
notes: Conference abstract (OFID/IDWeek 2024 Poster P-832). Descriptive only.

population_one_line: ICU bloodstream infections (true BSIs) Curitiba Brazil 2013-2018 (n=49 Candida)
ttp_reported: Mean TTP by organism; Candida 39h (SD 28.4); cutpoint 37h for mortality
outcome_one_line: Candida TTP<37h predicted mortality (AUC 0.733, sens 83%, spec 60%, p=0.005); no association for bacterial species
notes: Labeled 'Letter to the Editor' but is an original observational study with sufficient analysis. Candida subgroup n=49. Quantitative TTP↔mortality association reported only for Candida.

population_one_line: Adults with gram-negative BSI, 950-bed community hospital Texas (pre vs post RDT/AST)
outcome_one_line: Time to optimal therapy improved post-RDT (60.2 vs 29.0h); no change in mortality/LOS
notes: Conference abstract (OFID 2018 Suppl Poster #1807). RDT intervention study, no TTP exposure analyzed.

population_one_line: Adult MRSA bacteremia, multicenter pilot RCT DAP+CPT vs monotherapy
ttp_reported: Not reported — only duration of bacteremia (clearance time) measured
notes: Pilot RCT with mortality outcome but TTP of blood culture not measured/analyzed; the bacteremia duration variable is clearance time, not TTP.

population_one_line: Immunocompromised critically ill candidemia, 3 French ICUs 2002-2017
ttp_reported: Median delay to BC positivity 3 days (range 1-6); reported descriptively only
outcome_one_line: Hospital mortality 60%; predictors were vasopressors, mechanical ventilation, allogenic SCT — TTP NOT entered in univariate or multivariate analysis
notes: TTP reported but not analyzed against mortality. 'Days to first AF therapy' (time to treatment) was in Table 1 but not TTP itself.

population_one_line: Systematic review/meta-analysis: T2MR vs blood culture for BSI diagnosis (14 studies)
ttp_reported: Time to detection compared between T2MR and BC (MD -81h); not TTP↔outcome
outcome_one_line: T2MR shortened time to targeted therapy and LOS; mortality comparable (28.9% vs 29.9%, RR 1.02)
notes: Diagnostic methods comparison meta-analysis; TTP not the exposure in any patient-level outcome analysis.

population_one_line: K. pneumoniae BSI (KPC/ESBL/wild-type), tertiary hospital Bologna Italy 2010-2012
outcome_one_line: Inappropriate empirical therapy associated with 30-day mortality (HR 1.9, 1.1-3.4)
notes: Strong mortality outcome study but TTP of blood culture not measured or analyzed.

population_one_line: Narrative review of modern blood culture methods and management
ttp_reported: Discussed conceptually as turnaround time, not primary data
notes: Review article (Clin Lab Med). Not a primary study.
